full_schema_tables = [source0, source2, source6, source7]

# Join with source3 (VISITS_NUM)

# Join with source4 (COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM)

# Join with source8 (INBOUND_CALLS_NUM)

# Join with source9 (INTERACTIONS_NUM)

    "KEYWORDS_NUM", "VISITS_NUM", "COLLECTION_EVENTS_NUM",
    "TECHSUPPORT_NUM", "INBOUND_CALLS_NUM", "INTERACTIONS_NUM"
]
df[num_cols_fill_zero] = df[num_cols_fill_zero].fillna(0).astype(int)

    "CUST_SINCE_DT", "CANCEL_DT", "CITY", "POP"

    "INBOUND_CALLS_NUM": "sum",
    "KEYWORDS_NUM": "sum",
    "VISITS_NUM": "sum",
